graph.name: Consider recovery after an apology
graph.description:
Use a settled apology to propose a recovery update for temporary actor conditions.

Lesson: Recovery updates a temporary condition from settled events while retaining separately supported guarded beliefs. The next Pre workflow reads that committed state and expresses a reaction; a proposal alone never becomes memory.

Limitations: Full Post root Run writes memory without a review-click. A zero-call State Curve alternative requires an already initialized curve; it does not infer emotion.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Post: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Writes actor memory on full Run. Inspect local update and save acknowledgment separately; unconfirmed saving is not durable saving.

Try changing:
Change the settled apology from accepted to acknowledged without acceptance; inspect whether Recovery preserves the stronger unresolved condition.
Run to Internalize, inspect its sourceRefs, then compare a full root Run's settlement and save diagnostics before using the Pre companion.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Settled event: Sol apologized for reading Mira's letter. She accepted the apology.

Proposed update: Immediate anger eases. Trust remains guarded until later behavior supplies more evidence.

Post evidence → proposal → settlement: Keep State+Events→Internalize Recovery→Commit in a Post root workflow. Full Run may write actor memory without a review-click; report local update separately from confirmed saving.

Pre sources → interpretation → delivery: Wire Scene+State→Reflect Character, Reflect→Express Behavior, then Guidance; also feed the same Scene/State to Express. This companion reads actual committed state, never the Post proposal directly.

Recovery is evidence-based: Both model nodes need local Analysis bindings. This recipe has at most one request per phase. A zero-call Curve alternative requires an initialized curve and cannot infer the truth of an emotion.

Anger and guarded trust (post-state)
Purpose: Read Mira's scoped prior State so temporary anger and guarded relationship evidence can be treated as different items.
Fixture: Demo prerequisite: supported existing state records Mira's immediate anger after Sol read her letter and her guarded trust toward him. Plain JSON is not a scoped actor-state record; importing this example makes no live seed.
Inspect: Inspect actual conditions, relationships, sourceRefs and version. If guarded trust is absent, do not invent it merely to reproduce the specimen.

Accepted apology evidence (post-events)
Purpose: Read settled Events Data for the apology and acceptance; these references authorize the recovery proposal.
Fixture: Post demo prerequisite: a supported settled message says Sol apologized for reading Mira's letter; Mira accepted the apology. Use actual native event IDs and revisions in the same selected actor/chat scope.
Inspect: Confirm acceptance was actually settled, not only offered. Empty Events cannot support Internalize, and a fictional fixture string cannot create host event authority.

Ease anger; retain the boundary (post-internalize)
Purpose: Propose a recovery change for the temporary reaction while keeping supported guarded relationship state distinct.
Inspect: Run to here to inspect each proposed item and sourceRef. Expect a temporary-condition change with separately retained relationship evidence; no persistence happens at this node.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Settle recovery once (post-commit)
Purpose: Settle the validated proposal after a successful full Post root Run, using the native derived transaction key.
Inspect: Inspect the Commit Host diagnostic and separate local-update/save acknowledgment. Commit has no output pin and needs no review-click; previews and target runs never write.

post-internalize.title: Internalize · recovery
post-internalize.instructions:
Use only the supplied apology and acceptance events with exact IDs/revisions. Ease Mira's supported temporary anger if acceptance warrants it. Retain the prior guarded trust and unresolved letter-boundary consequence; acceptance of an apology is not proof of restored trust. Do not declare forgiveness, intimacy, baseline recovery or a new numeric trust score unless evidence explicitly supports it. Preserve enduring traits and unrelated items. Leave values, curves and tracks unchanged. Classify emotional easing as interpretation when not directly observed.

Return one raw JSON object, beginning with { and ending with }. No Markdown, fences or preface. Propose at most three best-supported changes, using exact supplied event IDs and revisions for sourceRefs. Keep values, curves and tracks as empty objects unless needed.
